cufmponder.ponder.ae2_controller.text_1: The ME Controller is the core of an ME Network. Every device on the network draws channels from it.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_controller.text_2: Place controllers next to each other and they merge into a larger multiblock, up to 7x7x7.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_controller.text_3: The bigger the multiblock, the more channels the network can provide.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_drive.text_1: Insert storage cells into an ME Drive and your network gains storage space.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_drive.text_2: A 1k storage cell finds its way into the drive.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_drive.text_3: One drive holds 10 cells, and you may mix cells of different sizes.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_drive.text_4: The front face holds the cells. Cables connect to any other side of the drive.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_energy.text_1: An ME Network needs energy to run.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_energy.text_2: The Energy Acceptor turns outside energy (FE) into AE, and feeds it into the network.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_energy.text_3: Place an Energy Cell next to it to buffer surplus AE for later.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_charger.text_1: The Charger uses AE energy to charge items placed inside.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_charger.text_2: Power it through the ME network, or crank it by hand.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_charger.text_3: Cells and rechargeable tools all charge here.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_inscriber.text_1: The Inscriber crafts circuits and processors.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_inscriber.text_2: Put the material in the middle and a press on top.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_inscriber.text_3: The four sides accept extra materials like silicon or redstone.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_autocrafting.text_: The autocrafting trio: Pattern Provider, Molecular Assembler and ME Interface.
Encode a pattern into the Interface, and the Pattern Provider hands the job to the Assembler.
When the network requests a craft, this setup builds it automatically.
cufmponder.ponder.ae2_quantum_ring.text_: A Quantum Ring is 8 Quantum Ring blocks in a circle with a Quantum Link in the middle.
Build one ring at each of two locations and pair the links.
Once paired, the two networks link wirelessly across dimensions - like a very long cable.
cufmponder.ponder.supp_spring_launcher.t: Fall onto a Spring Launcher from a height and it throws you right back up.
The higher you fall, the stronger the launch. Trigger height and power are configurable.
Build one at your base entrance for a bouncy way in.
cufmponder.ponder.supp_rope_pulley.text_: Ropes can be climbed. Walk into one to move up or down.
A Pulley Block extends and retracts its rope on its own.
Several pulleys can work together to lift a very heavy build - great for elevators.
cufmponder.ponder.tag.ae2.description: Every ponderable block from Applied Energistics 2
